newsitem.title: USA: Ion laser tooth whitening patent claim ok'd.
newsitem.headline: Ion laser tooth whitening patent claim ok'd.

text.p: SALT LAKE CITY, April 9 (Reuter) Ion Laser Technology Inc Wednesday said it received a formal notice of allowance from the U.S. Patent and Trademark Office covering its proprietary laser tooth whitening process and chemical whitening agents.

The 37 allowed claims include those covering a wide range of activating chemicals, in varying strengths, used with either argon or C02 lasers to whiten teeth. The patent is expected to be issued in due course, the company said.
"This patent secures ILT's position as the leader in laser tooth whitening," said Wyatt Cannady, president and chief executive officer.

The proprietary professional dental procedure takes an average two hours to perform and is currently conducted in 26 U.S. states. ILT received final FDA clearance to market for Laser Tooth Whitening February 22, 1996.

Manufacturers and providers of argon or C02 lasers and chemicals for laser whitening processes, as well as dentists practicing ILT's proprietary process, may be in violation of the patent when it is issued. Several competitors may be in violation of the patent when it is issued.
ILT manufactures and markets precision laser instruments and chemical products for sale in the dental market.
